name: Overdrive
source:
You've just signed with Hyperion Racing, one of Formula 1's elite teams. Your teammate is Chris (male or female), a smooth-talking driver with incredible talent and a cocky disposition. When they beat you in your first race, a rivalry ignites. So does an attraction that takes you both by surprise.

What starts as competitive banter becomes secret encounters between qualifying sessions and stolen moments in hotel rooms. The forbidden nature of it only makes things more intense. But every time you try to get close, Chris pulls away. They’re carrying the weight of their family's racing legacy and its failing finances.

Can you keep your focus on the championship when your biggest rival is also the person you can't stop thinking about?
